  "gradient": "linear-gradient(125deg,#115e59,#a3e635)",
  "gradientUsage": "Decorative only; place text on opaque semantic surfaces",
  "motion": {
    "durationSeconds": 31,
    "property": "transform and opacity on decorative pseudo-layer",
    "reducedMotion": "static; no autoplay movement"
  },
  "radiusRem": 1,
  "monoFont": "Geist Mono",
  "version": "1.0.0"

# Electric Mint

Original MigBits semantic theme. Light/dark CSS variables, decorative gradient, radius and typography roles.

1. Copy theme.css into your application's global styles.
2. Map the semantic variables through your existing Tailwind v4/shadcn @theme inline configuration. Add .dark to your theme root for dark mode.
3. Headings: Space Grotesk; body: DM Sans; code: Geist Mono. Font binaries are NOT included. Get the individually licensed families at https://migbits.com/library/typography and preserve their OFL notices.
4. Keep text on opaque semantic backgrounds; the decorative gradient is not a contrast-certified text surface.
5. Check keyboard focus, forced colors, disabled states and contrast in your final components.
